title: Daftar Driver Aktif
businessCase: Tim operasional membutuhkan daftar semua driver yang saat ini berstatus 'ACTIVE' untuk alokasi pengiriman hari ini.

tables.name: drivers
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE drivers (driver_id VARCHAR, name VARCHAR, status VARCHAR);

referenceQuery: SELECT driver_id, name FROM drivers WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'

title: Total Pendapatan per Metode Pembayaran
businessCase: Tim finance ingin mengetahui total nominal transaksi berdasarkan masing-masing metode pembayaran.

tables.name: payments
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id VARCHAR, method VARCHAR, amount INT);

referenceQuery: SELECT method, SUM(amount) as total_revenue FROM payments GROUP BY method

title: Jumlah Pesanan Dibatalkan
businessCase: Customer Service perlu mengetahui berapa banyak pesanan yang statusnya 'CANCELLED' pada bulan ini.

tables.name: orders
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id VARCHAR, status VARCHAR);

referenceQuery: SELECT COUNT(order_id) as total_cancelled FROM orders WHERE status = 'CANCELLED'

title: Rata-rata Rating Driver
businessCase: Evaluasi kinerja driver bulanan. Hitung rata-rata rating untuk masing-masing driver_id.

tables.name: reviews
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE reviews (review_id VARCHAR, driver_id VARCHAR, rating INT);

referenceQuery: SELECT driver_id, AVG(rating) as avg_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY driver_id

title: Pelanggan Asal Jakarta
businessCase: Marketing ingin mengirimkan promo khusus untuk pelanggan yang berdomisili di 'Jakarta'. Tampilkan nama pelanggan dan email mereka.

tables.name: customers
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id VARCHAR, name VARCHAR, email VARCHAR, city VARCHAR);

referenceQuery: SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE city = 'Jakarta'

title: Stok Produk Menipis
businessCase: Tim gudang butuh list produk yang stoknya kurang dari atau sama dengan 10 agar bisa segera di-restock.

tables.name: products
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE products (product_id VARCHAR, name VARCHAR, stock INT);
tables.insertSql: INSERT INTO products VALUES ('PRD1', 'Kardus Besar', 5), ('PRD2', 'Bubble Wrap', 50), ('PRD3', 'Lakban', 8);

referenceQuery: SELECT name, stock FROM products WHERE stock <= 10

title: Total Berat Paket per Hub
businessCase: Tim logistik perlu menghitung total berat paket (dalam kg) yang ada di setiap hub asal.

tables.name: packages
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE packages (package_id VARCHAR, origin_hub VARCHAR, weight_kg DECIMAL);

referenceQuery: SELECT origin_hub, SUM(weight_kg) as total_weight FROM packages GROUP BY origin_hub

title: Penggunaan Kode Promo
businessCase: Tampilkan daftar pesanan yang menggunakan kode promo (promo_code tidak null).

tables.name: transactions
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE transactions (trx_id VARCHAR, amount INT, promo_code VARCHAR);

referenceQuery: SELECT trx_id, amount, promo_code FROM transactions WHERE promo_code IS NOT NULL

title: Pesanan Lebih dari 100 Ribu
businessCase: Cari semua transaksi yang nominalnya (amount) di atas 100.000.

tables.name: transactions
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE transactions (trx_id VARCHAR, amount INT);

referenceQuery: SELECT trx_id, amount FROM transactions WHERE amount > 100000

title: Hub di Jawa Barat
businessCase: Tampilkan nama hub yang berlokasi di provinsi 'Jawa Barat'.

tables.name: hubs
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE hubs (hub_id VARCHAR, hub_name VARCHAR, province VARCHAR);
tables.insertSql: INSERT INTO hubs VALUES ('H01', 'Cakung Hub', 'DKI Jakarta'), ('H02', 'Tambun Hub', 'Jawa Barat'), ('H03', 'Cikarang Hub', 'Jawa Barat');

referenceQuery: SELECT hub_name FROM hubs WHERE province = 'Jawa Barat'

title: Pelanggan Pasif
businessCase: Tim CRM ingin mem-blast email retensi ke pelanggan yang mendaftar tapi belum pernah melakukan transaksi sama sekali.

tables.name: customers
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id VARCHAR, name VARCHAR);

tables.name: orders
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id VARCHAR, customer_id VARCHAR);

referenceQuery: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL
defaultQuery: SELECT * FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

title: Driver Rating Rendah Banyak Order
businessCase: Untuk keperluan coaching, cari driver yang sudah menyelesaikan lebih dari 5 pesanan, tetapi rata-rata ratingnya di bawah 4.0.

tables.name: driver_performance
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE driver_performance (driver_id VARCHAR, total_orders INT, avg_rating DECIMAL);

referenceQuery: SELECT driver_id, total_orders, avg_rating FROM driver_performance WHERE total_orders > 5 AND avg_rating < 4.0

title: Persentase Metode Pembayaran COD
businessCase: Hitung rasio (persentase) transaksi yang menggunakan metode COD dibandingkan total seluruh transaksi.

tables.name: payments
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id VARCHAR, method VARCHAR);

referenceQuery: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN method = 'COD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS cod_percentage FROM payments

title: Rata-rata Waktu Pengiriman per Provinsi
businessCase: Hitung rata-rata waktu yang dibutuhkan (dalam jam) dari barang dikirim (dispatched) hingga diterima (delivered) per provinsi asal hub.

tables.name: hubs
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE hubs (hub_id VARCHAR, province VARCHAR);
tables.insertSql: INSERT INTO hubs VALUES ('H01', 'DKI Jakarta'), ('H02', 'Jawa Barat');

tables.name: shipments
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id VARCHAR, hub_id VARCHAR, dispatched_at TIMESTAMP, delivered_at TIMESTAMP);

referenceQuery: SELECT h.province, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.delivered_at - s.dispatched_at))/3600) as avg_hours FROM hubs h JOIN shipments s ON h.hub_id = s.hub_id GROUP BY h.province
defaultQuery: SELECT * FROM hubs h JOIN shipments s ON h.hub_id = s.hub_id;

title: Kategori Produk Paling Laris
businessCase: Tampilkan nama kategori produk dan total kuantitas barang yang terjual dari kategori tersebut, urutkan dari yang terbanyak.

tables.name: categories
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE categories (category_id VARCHAR, category_name VARCHAR);

tables.name: order_items
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id VARCHAR, category_id VARCHAR, quantity INT);

referenceQuery: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(o.quantity) as total_sold FROM categories c JOIN order_items o ON c.category_id = o.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY total_sold DESC
defaultQuery: SELECT * FROM categories c JOIN order_items o ON c.category_id = o.category_id;

title: Top 2 Pelanggan Terbesar per Provinsi
businessCase: Untuk program VIP, cari 2 pelanggan dengan total nilai belanja tertinggi di masing-masing provinsi.

tables.name: customer_spending
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE customer_spending (customer_id VARCHAR, province VARCHAR, total_spent INT);
tables.insertSql: INSERT INTO customer_spending VALUES ('C1', 'DKI Jakarta', 500000), ('C2', 'DKI Jakarta', 700000), ('C3', 'DKI Jakarta', 200000), ('C4', 'Jawa Barat', 300000), ('C5', 'Jawa Barat', 800000), ('C6', 'Jawa Barat', 600000);

referenceQuery: WITH RankedSpending AS (SELECT customer_id, province, total_spent, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY province ORDER BY total_spent DESC) as rank FROM customer_spending) SELECT customer_id, province, total_spent FROM RankedSpending WHERE rank <= 2

title: Perbandingan Kinerja Pengiriman Driver
businessCase: Hitung selisih waktu pengiriman setiap order milik seorang driver, dibandingkan dengan rata-rata keseluruhan waktu pengiriman dari driver tersebut secara historis.

tables.name: deliveries
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE deliveries (delivery_id VARCHAR, driver_id VARCHAR, delivery_time_mins INT);

referenceQuery: SELECT delivery_id, driver_id, delivery_time_mins, AVG(delivery_time_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id) as avg_driver_time, (delivery_time_mins - AVG(delivery_time_mins) OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id)) as difference_from_avg FROM deliveries
